incumbent.text: Sink-first differential: instantiate the backend operations object with a disposable fake connection, compare EXPLAIN prefixes for legal and crafted option names, repair option-name validation at the public explain boundary, then rerun the matrix plus legal-option regression.

hint: A public queryset explain method forwards keyword options to a query-level explain method, which stores the format and options for a compiler. On a SQL backend the prefix builder uppercases each option name and interpolates it into EXPLAIN (...), and a fake feature object reproduces the vulnerable prefix. The only attacker-controlled field is an option name supplied through dictionary expansion. The next question is whether validating option names at the public query-level explain method removes the injection and how a baseline fixture should distinguish a legitimate option from a malformed one.
